title: "Is on a holiday of" ignores a holiday list that is not attached to business hours
label: BUG vs ZOHO
date: TAVI 7 Nov 2026 (holiday on 7 Nov 2026) · Zoho 7 Nov 2026 (live, form opened and cancelled, nothing saved)
env: TAVI staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging, owner) · rule QA AS6 B08 holiday, Dept QA AS6 Dept A · Zoho Desk org techsolutionsegypt (Enterprise trial, admin)

panels.caption: TAVI: Setup → Holidays — "QA AS6 HOL today" (one holiday: 7 Nov 2026), Business hours: Not attached
TAVI: rule QA AS6 B08 holiday, Target 1: Subject contains "QA AS6 HOL t1" AND Execution Time is on a holiday of QA AS6 HOL today → Test User 1 (Target 2: is not on a holiday of → Mahmoud Samy)
TAVI: #1252 "QA AS6 HOL t1 detached r2" created on 7 Nov — Unassigned (target 1 did not match)
TAVI: #1254 "QA AS6 HOL t2 detached r2" — assigned to Mahmoud Samy by target 2 ("not on a holiday")
Zoho: Setup → Holiday Lists → New Holiday List — Business Hours is an optional switch (off by default) (closed with Cancel)

rows: A holiday list can be saved with the Business Hours switch off (seen on the New Holiday List form).
Same: Holidays page shows "QA AS6 HOL today" with Business hours "Not attached".
Execution Time "on a holiday of / not a holiday of" a holiday list (seen earlier in Zoho's rule criteria). Whether Zoho's picker offers lists without business hours was not checked.
The rule's picker offers the unattached list and the rule saves: "Execution Time is on a holiday of QA AS6 HOL today".
Expected: on 7 Nov a ticket matches "on a holiday of" a list that contains 7 Nov. Zoho's runtime with an unattached list was not checked (it would need a list created in Zoho).

"On a holiday of" did NOT match (#1252 stayed Unassigned) and "not on a holiday of" DID match (#1254 → Mahmoud Samy): today is treated as a working day. After attaching the same list to business hours "QA AS6 BH", the same rule worked (#1233 → Test User 1, #1234 no match). A list with only 25 Dec behaves correctly either way.
